lastCompletedStory.title: Replace the content-matching submission oracle with the geometry oracle

nextStoryContext: isComposerEmptied and all capturePaneFn-based content-matching are retired from src/tmux/dispatch.ts. sendKeysVerified now derives its delivery verdict from geometryUnchanged(baseline, after): a per-attempt cursor-geometry pair (cursorX, cursorY) sampled via sampleGeometryFn (default sampleCursorGeometry, src/tmux/display-message.ts) immediately before each send-keys call (the baseline) and again after SEND_KEYS_SETTLE_MS (the post-send read). capturePaneFn is now used ONLY by the pre-send idle-gate (waitForIdlePane/isOrchPaneIdle), never for the delivery verdict. Every fake TmuxSpawnFn across the test suite that routes through sendKeysVerified/sendKeysWhenIdle now needs a 'display-message' branch answering a fixed geometry line (e.g. '2;26;80;30') so the verdict resolves deterministically to delivered-on-attempt-1 unless a test deliberately stages otherwise -- see the display-message stubs added in test/review.test.ts, test/commands/spec.test.ts, test/single-pusher-guard.test.ts, test/supervisor/host-notify-orch.test.ts, test/supervisor/notify-orchestrator.test.ts, test/supervisor/orchestrator-surface.test.ts for the pattern. US-003 (thread logEvent into the four sendKeysWhenIdle call sites) touches production call sites of sendKeysWhenIdle, not the oracle itself; if any of those call sites has its own hand-rolled fake tmux spawn (not one of the six already updated above), it will need the same display-message stub or its sendKeysVerified call will misreport delivery in tests. Real-tmux integration coverage lives in test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts (4 tests, all against a real tmux server on a private socket, pane pinned to -x 80): UNDELIVERED wrapping payload, DELIVERED payload, and both directions at the exact wrap-boundary length, using test/fixtures/dispatch-geometry/raw-echo.ts (a raw-stdin receiver with 'submit'|'drop' modes and an eager \r\n wrap) as the pane's command instead of a real claude binary.

officialDocsValidated.summary: The FORMATS section excerpt returned by the fetch did not include per-variable prose for cursor_x/cursor_y specifically, so the doc fetch alone was inconclusive. Corroborated instead by the 4 real-tmux integration tests in test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts (all pass against a live tmux server, not mocked): cursor_x/cursor_y round-trip as server-side state independent of pane text content, confirming the oracle's premise. Same lib/URL family already validated for the round-trip parse contract in US-001's handoff entry.
